channel.title: Call Recorder Updates
channel.description: Appcast feed for Call Recorder automatic updates.

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0 (build 116)
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0 (build 116)

  • Fixed the WhisperKit local transcription engine, which could never work. Its model download always failed, and even with a model in place it failed to start, so selecting it silently fell through to the cloud engine instead of transcribing on your Mac.
  • WhisperKit now downloads the intended large-v3-turbo model and transcribes locally, with word timings and language detection as expected. The model is around 1.6 GB and goes to your chosen model storage folder, where the Model Storage section in Preferences shows and manages it as usual.

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0 (build 115)
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0 (build 115)

  • New Model Storage section in Preferences > Transcription: shows the full path where downloaded speech models are kept, with a Show in Finder button, so it is always clear what is stored where.
  • Choose your own model storage folder. Pick any folder you can write to, or reset to the default, and the app offers to move existing models across rather than re-downloading them. Both the WhisperKit and ivrit.ai Hebrew engines follow your choice.
  • If a custom model folder is missing or its disk is not connected, the app warns and falls back to the default location instead of failing or re-downloading to the wrong place. Your chosen folder is remembered and used again once it is available.
  • Per-model disk usage breakdown, marking each model as in use or unused by your selected engine.
  • New Delete unused models action, which itemises every file and its size and asks for confirmation before removing anything. Recordings, transcripts, and the built-in voice-print model are never touched. It appears only when there is real space to reclaim.
  • Clears the leftover huggingface folder an older version created in Documents.
  • Each transcription engine now states whether it supports the custom terms list, and the Custom Terms editor is greyed out with an explanation when the selected engine ignores it. Your terms are always kept.
  • Fixed WhisperKit model detection, which previously reported an already-downloaded model as missing.

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0 (build 114)
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0 (build 114)

  • Settings: the Transcripts root shown under Auto-Filing now always matches the folder recordings are actually filed into, and warns when no root can be resolved.
  • Settings: the Pyannote API key section is greyed out when the current transcription provider does not use Pyannote, and an unselected engine's configuration no longer looks switched on. Saved keys are kept either way.
  • New Default Language preference in the Transcription tab: choose Auto-detect or Hebrew (forced). A per-call change now reverts to your default after each call ends.
  • Auto-detect is now a first-class option and the default. Hebrew (forced) locks transcription to Hebrew; Auto-detect transcribes in the detected language and still auto-translates Hebrew to English when translation is on. Pyannote STT always auto-detects.
  • New warning after a call when a forced language does not match the language actually spoken, so a mis-set language no longer produces a wrong transcript silently.

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0 (build 113)
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0 (build 113)

  • Overhauled the first-run permissions setup with a clearer, simpler onboarding wizard.
  • Added recovery from a denied microphone permission: reset the permission and re-prompt without reinstalling.
  • Auto-relaunches after you grant Screen Recording, and brings the app back to front when you return from System Settings.
  • Update dialogs now show the build number (for example "1.0 (build 113)").
  • New reveal-toggle secure fields for entering API keys.

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0 (build 112)
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0 (build 112)

  • Refreshed design language across the menu bar menu, recording pills, equalizer, and Preferences pane.
  • Added a confirmation dialogue before discarding a recording.
  • Falls back to the system default microphone when the selected device is unavailable.
  • Added in-app microphone recording for voiceprint enrollment, with UX improvements.
  • Fixed 3-channel microphone format creation.

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0 (build 111)
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0 (build 111)

  • A new call is always auto-detected after manually stopping and saving a recording.
  • The update window shows the build number.
  • Fixed a CPU spin after recordings ended.
  • Chunked-mix alignment fixes for long recordings.
  • Raw audio tracks kept forever by default (configurable in Preferences).

item.title: Call Recorder 1.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 1.0

Call Recorder reaches 1.0. Same hardened code as 0.7.0, now the official 1.0 release:

  • Recordings can no longer be lost to transient errors - failed transcriptions and recovery problems retry instead of discarding audio.
  • Fixed freezes when switching microphone mid-recording and when quitting during a recording.
  • Interrupted recordings are reconstructed on the next launch.
  • Manage local transcription models from Preferences: reveal in Finder or delete to free disk space.
  • Hardened model downloads, API-key storage, and log privacy.

item.title: Call Recorder 0.7.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.7.0

Major reliability release:

  • Recordings can no longer be lost to transient errors - failed transcriptions and recovery problems now retry instead of discarding audio.
  • Fixed freezes when switching microphone mid-recording and when quitting during a recording (quit now saves and exits in about two seconds).
  • Interrupted recordings are reconstructed on the next launch, even if one audio track is missing.
  • The transcription queue retries transient failures automatically instead of stalling.
  • Manage local transcription models from Preferences: reveal in Finder or delete to free disk space (with confirmation).
  • Hardened model downloads, API-key storage, and log privacy.

item.title: Call Recorder 0.6.1
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.6.1

File and folder names are now always in English, even on Hebrew calls:

  • Names are transliterated to Latin script (e.g. יובל becomes Yuval).
  • Subjects are translated to English.

item.title: Call Recorder 0.6.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.6.0

Local, on-device transcription:

  • New engine picker with one-click download (Apple Speech, ivrit.ai for Hebrew, WhisperKit) - transcribe without the cloud or an API key.
  • On-device translation option (no key needed) for supported languages.
  • Automatic speaker names: clear two-party calls are labelled with your name vs the other party.
  • The recording menu now shows the file currently being transcribed.
  • Each engine can have a primary + fallback.
  • The in-call pill can now be placed over the menu bar (defaults to centered, top).
  • Taller Preferences window; clearer 'model version' wording.

item.title: Call Recorder 0.5.5
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.5.5

New features and improvements:

  • Auto-rename recordings: After transcription, recordings are now renamed to include who you spoke with and what the call was about. Format: yyyy.MM.dd@HH.mm Company - Person - Subject. Configurable in Preferences > Transcription.
  • Permission setup is more reliable: microphone, screen-recording-needs-restart, and notification recovery now guide you correctly.

item.title: Call Recorder 0.5.4
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.5.4

Performance and stability improvements:

  • Performance: processing after long calls now uses a fraction of the memory it used to.
  • Stability: fixed small resource leaks and tightened recording finalisation; large internal cleanup.
  • Cancelled recordings now reliably land in the Discarded folder, including when cancelled right at the start.
  • The pill's cancel button is now labelled "Cancel & discard" to match the safer behaviour (recordings go to the Discarded folder, not deleted).

item.title: Call Recorder 0.5.3
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.5.3

Improvements and fixes:

  • In-call pill timer now matches the menu-bar timer exactly.
  • Recordings are now organised into Year / Date folders.
  • Changing the recordings folder now asks whether to move your existing recordings to the new location.
  • Fixed: a call answered on the Mac (including switching to AirPods mid-call) is no longer wrongly discarded as "answered on your phone".
  • Discarded recordings are now moved to a "Discarded" folder instead of deleted, and are auto-removed after a configurable period (default 30 days).

item.title: Call Recorder 0.5.2
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.5.2

Bug fixes:

  • Voice recognition (speaker naming) now works reliably - fixes a sample-rate bug that corrupted enrolled voiceprints. If you enrolled a voice on an earlier version, please delete it and re-enrol (Preferences > Voices).
  • Pre-call echo removed: the brief echo at the very start of a recording (the calling app's self-monitor/sidetone before the call connects) is now suppressed. In-call audio is unchanged.

item.title: Call Recorder 0.5.1
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.5.1

Improvements:

  • Redesigned Preferences with a modern macOS System Settings look: colored sidebar icons, grouped cards, cleaner layout across every tab
  • In-call spectrum visualiser retuned so normal speech animates the middle of the bars (not bunched in the bass)

item.title: Call Recorder 0.5.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.5.0

Major feature release:

  • Wideband audio: recordings now capture at 32kHz HE-AAC for noticeably crisper, clearer voices (especially the remote party), at about the same file size
  • New floating in-call pill with pause, stop & save, and cancel controls, plus a live audio spectrum
  • Gapless pause/resume (also from the menu)
  • Voice-print enrolment: enrol people's voices in Preferences > Voices so transcripts name speakers instead of "Speaker 1/2"
  • Auto-discards a recording when a call is answered on your iPhone instead of the Mac
  • Interface refresh and Preferences fixes (sidebar, version display)

item.title: Call Recorder 0.4.5
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.4.5

Audio mixing adjustment:

  • SOFT-DUCK ducking depth adjusted to -9 dB to keep the local voice louder during mis-assigned segments

item.title: Call Recorder 0.4.4
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.4.4

Transcription and UI improvements:

  • Diarization with Speaker 1/2/3 labelling
  • Capture-failure notifications
  • Modern UI with auto-detect toggle
  • Version display fix
  • SOFT-DUCK -15dB audio ducking during calls

item.title: Call Recorder 0.3.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.3.0

Quality and organization improvements:

  • Per-day date folders for recordings
  • Consistent output volume normalization

item.title: Call Recorder 0.2.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.2.0

Major update with onboarding wizard and improvements:

  • First-run setup wizard for easy configuration
  • Fixes call-handoff split recordings
  • Multi-provider transcription support
  • UI refresh

item.title: Call Recorder 0.1.0
item.description:
Call Recorder 0.1.0

Initial release with full call recording functionality:

  • Two-track recording (microphone + system audio)
  • Automatic call detection
  • Menu bar interface with recording controls
  • Sparkle auto-update support
